about: Domaine LeSeurre was founded by Sébastien and Céline LeSeurre, who came to the Finger Lakes from France in 2011. Sébastien is the sixth generation of a Champagne winemaking family; Céline grew up with family vineyards in southwest France. After working harvests on four continents, they chose Keuka Lake for its cool climate and its suitability for vinifera grapes as the climate warms, made their first vintage in 2012 and opened a tasting room on the lake’s east shore in 2013.

Riesling is the region’s signature grape, and the LeSeurres source it from growers across the Finger Lakes, some from vines planted in 1971. They pick by taste and blend lots from different soils: shale for minerality and acidity, clay for fruit. The Cuvée Classique Dry Riesling is fermented and aged in stainless steel for about nine months, with regular stirring of the lees for texture. Expect lime zest, green apple and white peach with crushed stone, and a taut, citrus-pith finish; with several years in bottle, the 2017 has had time to deepen.
